name: – Tomáš Zdechovský – After § 96 – Am 6
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2023
part_text: 96b. Deeply regrets the significant and undeniable waste of European taxpayers' money, as at least 215 million COVID-19 vaccine doses have been discarded, amounting to a loss of over EUR 4 billion;
